entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State where no ESM procedure transaction is active in the UE.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State where the UE has initiated an ESM procedure transaction towards the network and is awaiting response.

entities.name: UE initiated ESM procedure request
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE initiates an ESM procedure request.

entities.name: UE initiated ESM procedure reject by network
entities.description: Condition triggered when network rejects UE initiated ESM procedure.

entities.name: Network initiated ESM procedure
entities.description: Condition triggered when network initiates an ESM procedure.

relations.description: UE initiated ESM procedure request causes transition from PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
UE initiated ESM procedure reject by network causes transition from PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
Network initiated ESM procedure causes transition from PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
